content.text:
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at pub-get/test-build time, so the
      # placeholders must exist BEFORE flutter pub get. Content mirrors the
      # proven build-macos.yml incantation (bare `touch` produced "No file or
      # variants found for asset: .env" on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored; the tracked placeholder makes it
      # compile (Firebase init is skipped for YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # gh-1296 NG1: the Podfile.lock half of the lockfile gate. pub get just
      # generated .flutter-plugins-dependencies; the gate fails the PR when a
      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

Almost certainly `_watchUiTree` or a related new function in `js_app_engine.dart` — new code with partial coverage → CRAP = cc² × (1-cov)³ + cc... Actually CRAP formula: `crap = comp^2 * (1 - cov)^3 + comp` where cov is coverage fraction. If cc=3 and coverage ~0.x: 3²·(1-cov)³+3. For CRAP 30.12: comp=3 → 9(1-cov)³+3 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 3.013 → impossible (max 9+3=12 when cov=0). comp=4: 16(1-cov)³+4 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.6325 → 1-cov = 1.177 > 1 impossible. comp=5: 25(1-cov)³+5=30.12 → (1-cov)³=1.0048 → 1-cov ≈ 1.0016 → cov ≈ 0% (rounding). Hmm so cc=5 at 0% coverage → 25+5=30. CRAP 30.12 → 25(1-cov)³ + 5 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 → cov ≈ -0.16%? That's odd. Maybe cov is a tiny nonzero: (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 means 1-cov = 1.00159 → cov = -0.0016. Negative coverage? That can't be.

Hmm, 30.12 could come from a different formula variant: CRAP1 = cc²·(1-cov)³ + cc; with cov=0, cc=5 → 30. 30.12 is close. Maybe the analyzer computes coverage over a slightly bigger range with average cov slightly > 0: cov = 0.1%: 25·(0.999)³+5 = 29.99. cov negative isn't possible...

Maybe formula includes rounding differently, e.g. uses block coverage percentage 0.04 → 25·(1-0.0004)... no.

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at pub-get/test-build time, so the
      # placeholders must exist BEFORE flutter pub get. Content mirrors the
      # proven build-macos.yml incantation (bare `touch` produced "No file or
      # variants found for asset: .env" on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored; the tracked placeholder makes it
      # compile (Firebase init is skipped for YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # gh-1296 NG1: the Podfile.lock half of the lockfile gate. pub get just
      # generated .flutter-plugins-dependencies; the gate fails the PR when a
      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

Actually CRAP formula: `crap = comp^2 * (1 - cov)^3 + comp` where cov is coverage fraction. If cc=3 and coverage ~0.x: 3²·(1-cov)³+3. For CRAP 30.12: comp=3 → 9(1-cov)³+3 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 3.013 → impossible (max 9+3=12 when cov=0). comp=4: 16(1-cov)³+4 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.6325 → 1-cov = 1.177 > 1 impossible. comp=5: 25(1-cov)³+5=30.12 → (1-cov)³=1.0048 → 1-cov ≈ 1.0016 → cov ≈ 0% (rounding). Hmm so cc=5 at 0% coverage → 25+5=30. CRAP 30.12 → 25(1-cov)³ + 5 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 → cov ≈ -0.16%? That's odd. Maybe cov is a tiny nonzero: (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 means 1-cov = 1.00159 → cov = -0.0016. Negative coverage? That can't be.

Maybe the analyzer computes coverage over a slightly bigger range with average cov slightly > 0: cov = 0.1%: 25·(0.999)³+5 = 29.99. cov negative isn't possible...

Maybe formula includes rounding differently, e.g. uses block coverage percentage 0.04 → 25·(1-0.0004)... no.

      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

blocks.text:
Found the root cause of the CRAP ratchet failure:

```
CRAP threshold exceeded: 30.12 > 30.0
```

The pinned threshold in `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml` is 30.0, and some function now measures 30.12 CRAP. Almost certainly `_watchUiTree` or a related new function in `js_app_engine.dart` — new code with partial coverage → CRAP = cc² × (1-cov)³ + cc... Actually CRAP formula: `crap = comp^2 * (1 - cov)^3 + comp` where cov is coverage fraction. If cc=3 and coverage ~0.x: 3²·(1-cov)³+3. For CRAP 30.12: comp=3 → 9(1-cov)³+3 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 3.013 → impossible (max 9+3=12 when cov=0). comp=4: 16(1-cov)³+4 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.6325 → 1-cov = 1.177 > 1 impossible. comp=5: 25(1-cov)³+5=30.12 → (1-cov)³=1.0048 → 1-cov ≈ 1.0016 → cov ≈ 0% (rounding). Hmm so cc=5 at 0% coverage → 25+5=30. CRAP 30.12 → 25(1-cov)³ + 5 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 → cov ≈ -0.16%? That's odd. Maybe cov is a tiny nonzero: (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 means 1-cov = 1.00159 → cov = -0.0016. Negative coverage? That can't be.

Alternative: the threshold check might use "max CRAP score" across functions where the max function has CRAP 30.12 with cc=5 and coverage 0%... that gives 30. Hmm, 30.12 could come from a different formula variant: CRAP1 = cc²·(1-cov)³ + cc; with cov=0, cc=5 → 30. 30.12 is close. Maybe the analyzer computes coverage over a slightly bigger range with average cov slightly > 0: cov = 0.1%: 25·(0.999)³+5 = 29.99. cov negative isn't possible...

Maybe formula includes rounding differently, e.g. uses block coverage percentage 0.04 → 25·(1-0.0004)... no.

Let me not guess; download the crap_report.json artifact to see the offender. The artifact ID 11456940495 was uploaded. `gh run download` or `gh api`.

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at pub-get/test-build time, so the
      # placeholders must exist BEFORE flutter pub get. Content mirrors the
      # proven build-macos.yml incantation (bare `touch` produced "No file or
      # variants found for asset: .env" on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored; the tracked placeholder makes it
      # compile (Firebase init is skipped for YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # gh-1296 NG1: the Podfile.lock half of the lockfile gate. pub get just
      # generated .flutter-plugins-dependencies; the gate fails the PR when a
      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

blocks.text:
Found the root cause of the CRAP ratchet failure:

```
CRAP threshold exceeded: 30.12 > 30.0
```

The pinned threshold in `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml` is 30.0, and some function now measures 30.12 CRAP. Almost certainly `_watchUiTree` or a related new function in `js_app_engine.dart` — new code with partial coverage → CRAP = cc² × (1-cov)³ + cc... Actually CRAP formula: `crap = comp^2 * (1 - cov)^3 + comp` where cov is coverage fraction. If cc=3 and coverage ~0.x: 3²·(1-cov)³+3. For CRAP 30.12: comp=3 → 9(1-cov)³+3 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 3.013 → impossible (max 9+3=12 when cov=0). comp=4: 16(1-cov)³+4 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.6325 → 1-cov = 1.177 > 1 impossible. comp=5: 25(1-cov)³+5=30.12 → (1-cov)³=1.0048 → 1-cov ≈ 1.0016 → cov ≈ 0% (rounding). Hmm so cc=5 at 0% coverage → 25+5=30. CRAP 30.12 → 25(1-cov)³ + 5 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 → cov ≈ -0.16%? That's odd. Maybe cov is a tiny nonzero: (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 means 1-cov = 1.00159 → cov = -0.0016. Negative coverage? That can't be.

Alternative: the threshold check might use "max CRAP score" across functions where the max function has CRAP 30.12 with cc=5 and coverage 0%... that gives 30. Hmm, 30.12 could come from a different formula variant: CRAP1 = cc²·(1-cov)³ + cc; with cov=0, cc=5 → 30. 30.12 is close. Maybe the analyzer computes coverage over a slightly bigger range with average cov slightly > 0: cov = 0.1%: 25·(0.999)³+5 = 29.99. cov negative isn't possible...

Maybe formula includes rounding differently, e.g. uses block coverage percentage 0.04 → 25·(1-0.0004)... no.

Let me not guess; download the crap_report.json artifact to see the offender. The artifact ID 11456940495 was uploaded. `gh run download` or `gh api`.

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at pub-get/test-build time, so the
      # placeholders must exist BEFORE flutter pub get. Content mirrors the
      # proven build-macos.yml incantation (bare `touch` produced "No file or
      # variants found for asset: .env" on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored; the tracked placeholder makes it
      # compile (Firebase init is skipped for YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # gh-1296 NG1: the Podfile.lock half of the lockfile gate. pub get just
      # generated .flutter-plugins-dependencies; the gate fails the PR when a
      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

Actually CRAP formula: `crap = comp^2 * (1 - cov)^3 + comp` where cov is coverage fraction. If cc=3 and coverage ~0.x: 3²·(1-cov)³+3. Hmm so cc=5 at 0% coverage → 25+5=30. CRAP 30.12 → 25(1-cov)³ + 5 = 30.12 → (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 → cov ≈ -0.16%? That's odd. Maybe cov is a tiny nonzero: (1-cov)³ = 1.0048 means 1-cov = 1.00159 → cov = -0.0016. Negative coverage? That can't be.

Maybe the analyzer computes coverage over a slightly bigger range with average cov slightly > 0: cov = 0.1%: 25·(0.999)³+5 = 29.99. cov negative isn't possible...

Maybe formula includes rounding differently, e.g. uses block coverage percentage 0.04 → 25·(1-0.0004)... no.

blocks.text:
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at pub-get/test-build time, so the
      # placeholders must exist BEFORE flutter pub get. Content mirrors the
      # proven build-macos.yml incantation (bare `touch` produced "No file or
      # variants found for asset: .env" on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored; the tracked placeholder makes it
      # compile (Firebase init is skipped for YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # gh-1296 NG1: the Podfile.lock half of the lockfile gate. pub get just
      # generated .flutter-plugins-dependencies; the gate fails the PR when a
      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at pub-get/test-build time, so the
      # placeholders must exist BEFORE flutter pub get. Content mirrors the
      # proven build-macos.yml incantation (bare `touch` produced "No file or
      # variants found for asset: .env" on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored; the tracked placeholder makes it
      # compile (Firebase init is skipped for YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # gh-1296 NG1: the Podfile.lock half of the lockfile gate. pub get just
      # generated .flutter-plugins-dependencies; the gate fails the PR when a
      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at pub-get/test-build time, so the
      # placeholders must exist BEFORE flutter pub get. Content mirrors the
      # proven build-macos.yml incantation (bare `touch` produced "No file or
      # variants found for asset: .env" on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored; the tracked placeholder makes it
      # compile (Firebase init is skipped for YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # gh-1296 NG1: the Podfile.lock half of the lockfile gate. pub get just
      # generated .flutter-plugins-dependencies; the gate fails the PR when a
      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

blocks.text:
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at pub-get/test-build time, so the
      # placeholders must exist BEFORE flutter pub get. Content mirrors the
      # proven build-macos.yml incantation (bare `touch` produced "No file or
      # variants found for asset: .env" on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4).
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored; the tracked placeholder makes it
      # compile (Firebase init is skipped for YOUR_* values at runtime).
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # gh-1296 NG1: the Podfile.lock half of the lockfile gate. pub get just
      # generated .flutter-plugins-dependencies; the gate fails the PR when a
      # native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by the committed pubspec.lock has no
      # pod in the platform's Podfile.lock, or its pod is pinned at a stale
      # version vs the resolved podspec (the gh-1274 class, plus the
      # flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew this PR fixed). Self-tested in
      # Static gates (AC2).
      - name: Lockfile pod-sync gate (gh-1296 NG1)
        run: bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh pod-sync

      # gh-1232 AC2: the core static-gates size guard only scans
      # lib/test/example/bin — flutter_app/lib was never measured in CI
      # (scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh measures it only when APP_IN_SCOPE). Same
      # generated-file exclusions as the core guard.
      - name: File size guard (flutter_app, no dart file over 2800 lines)
        run: |
          violations=$(find flutter_app/lib -name '*.dart' \
            ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' ! -name '*.mocks.dart' \
            ! -name '*bridge_generated*.dart' ! -name '*app_localizations*.dart' \
            ! -name '*localizations_*.dart' \
            -exec sh -c 'lines=$(wc -l < "$1"); if [ "$lines" -gt 2800 ]; then echo "$1: $lines lines"; fi' _ {} \;)
          if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "$violations"; exit 1; fi

      - name: flutter analyze
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings

  # flutter_app tests sharded ×2 by a deterministic modulo split of the
  # sorted suite (same file list as before — golden + cli_visual stay out,
  # host-locked): each leg is ~half the test phase; pub-cache shared with
  # flutter-analyze so a warm leg pair reuses downloads.
  flutter-tests:
    name: Flutter app tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
    # End-of-run drain can stall minutes under shared-runner load while
    # every test already passed (0 failures, killed mid-drain on #330):
    # fa_ui shards get 12m and flutter_app is the heaviest package.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # arm64: no official linux-arm64 release tarball (x64-only manifest) —
      # subosito/flutter-action cannot fetch stable here. Bootstrap via git
      # clone instead: flutter_tools pulls the official arm64 Dart SDK itself.
      - name: Flutter SDK (arm64 git bootstrap)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
          echo "$HOME/flutter/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
          flutter --version
          flutter precache
      - name: Pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pubcache-flutter-${{ runner.os }}-

      # See flutter-analyze: placeholder must exist before pub get.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Golden suite is intentionally NOT here: goldens are host-locked
      # (same macOS host renders them differently across minor SDKs — see the
      # dynamic_messages saga) and would all redden on ubuntu. Widget/unit
      # tests run here on a cheap runner; goldens stay guarded by
      # build-macos.yml and the nightly full matrix (issue #177 E5/OQ3:
      # pinned-font golden migration is a follow-up, not this card).
      - name: flutter test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
        # Goldens stay out (host-locked, see the golden comment above).
        # Native-dependent tests (quickjs_c_bridge .so, mic channel) are NOT
        # excluded — issue #184 made them host-portable via the skip guard in
        # flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart + the injected-ASR fix.
        # Deterministic modulo split of the sorted file list: shard i takes
        # lines where NR % 2 == i — union == the old single job's list.
        run: |
          cd flutter_app
          find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*' \
            | sort | awk -v i=${{ matrix.shard }} 'NR % 2 == i' > shard-files.txt
          echo "shard files: $(wc -l < shard-files.txt)"
          # --coverage (issue #433): each shard emits lcov for the
          # app-crap-gate job; the covered surface matches the CRAP
          # sources [lib] exactly.
          flutter test --exclude-tags integration --coverage $(cat shard-files.txt)

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: app-coverage-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info
          retention-days: 2

      # Issue #239 AC3: the App Store submission pre-flight matrix is plain
      # ruby over flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb — no gems,
      # runs in under a second on the runner's stock ruby.
      # Issue #289 adds the fastlane guard/preflight suites (android id
      # guard + Play upload pre-flight) — same plain-ruby contract, so the
      # step loops over every fastlane test file. Shard 0 only: once is
      # enough (fa PR #333).
      - name: Fastlane pre-flight suites (ruby)
        if: matrix.shard == 0
        run: |
          for t in flutter_app/fastlane/test/*_test.rb; do
            echo "::group::ruby $t"
            ruby "$t"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done
